preconditions.description: The size of the chessboard is between 1 and 1000.
The initial X-coordinate of the Knight is between 1 and N.
The initial Y-coordinate of the Knight is between 1 and N.
The target X-coordinate is between 1 and N.
The target Y-coordinate is between 1 and N.

postconditions.description: The output is the minimum number of steps required for the Knight to reach the target position.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 if it is not possible for the Knight to reach the target position
postconditions.description: The output is -1 if the Knight cannot reach the target position from its initial position.
